matching.distribution_scope: Successful directions only; failed sampled CPU is separate.

deduplication.distribution_scope: Successful directions only; failed sampled CPU is separate.

decoding.distribution_scope: Successful directions only; failed sampled CPU is separate.

verification.distribution_scope: Successful directions only; failed sampled CPU is separate.

measurement_scope: Task CPU and compute wall include stage preparation and input loading; publication is separate. Matching direction wall is a sum across cut/seed tasks, not elapsed latency. Stage elapsed includes scheduling, publication and coordinator overhead. RSS is sampled; process-lifetime high water is not used. Missing complete-task timings on timed-out checks are null, not zero; their sampled CPU and consumed time remain separate.
